show.description: Ek raat nashe me Rajat aur Priya ke beech woh hua jisne unki zindagi hamesha ke liye badal di. Subah ek galatfahmi ne Priya ko Rajat se door kar diya. Iske baad Priya ne saat anokhe bachchon ko janam diya—har ek me chhupi thi ek ajeeb taaqat. Rajat use har jagah dhoondhta raha, par kismat ne kabhi unhe milne na diya. Ab wahi saat bachche apne maa-baap ko milane nikle… kya woh apne maksad me kaamyaab ho paayenge?
